name: Inclisiran
description: A GalNAc-conjugated small interfering RNA that silences hepatic PCSK9 synthesis, approved as an adjunct for LDL cholesterol lowering and dosed twice yearly after a loading dose.

systems.note: Hepatic PCSK9 silencing lowering LDL cholesterol; the labelled indication.
GalNAc conjugation targets the hepatocyte; hepatic exposure is by design.

monitors.why: The direct index of effect; the dosing interval means fewer opportunities to read it.
Particle count at low LDL-C values.
